name: langfuse-observability
description: Assimilate Langfuse observability and evaluation evidence into Ouroboros handoff/provenance workflows.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Fetch Langfuse trace evidence and emit an Ouroboros handoff artifact.

arguments.name: trace_url_or_id
arguments.description: Langfuse trace URL or trace ID to inspect.

commands.name: score
commands.summary: Publish an Ouroboros evaluation score to Langfuse and record provenance.

arguments.name: artifact_path
arguments.description: Ouroboros artifact containing trace or observation context.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Score value; parsed as numeric, boolean, or categorical by the plugin.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record Langfuse evidence summaries and plugin decisions.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record remote Langfuse trace and score source references.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist resumable fetch and publish status.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach Langfuse evidence to downstream Ouroboros execution.

permissions.reason: Fetch traces, observations, scores, and metrics from the Langfuse Public API.
Publish scores or evaluation results to Langfuse when the score command is invoked.
Read local Ouroboros artifacts for score publication or offline fixtures.
Write local handoff and provenance artifacts.
